# onetsolutions_hosting_database (Resource)

Manages a MySQL database of a web hosting.

!> **Destroying deletes the data.** Destroying the resource, or a change that replaces it
(`hosting_id`, or a `name` that is not another spelling of the same database), deletes the
database and every table in it; `terraform plan` warns before it does. `deletion_protection = true`
refuses the destroy.

## Names

The web hosting prefixes every database name with its username and an underscore: `name = "shop"`
on the web hosting of user `acme` creates `acme_shop`, given in `full_name`, the name applications
connect to. `name` may be written with or without the prefix; changing one spelling for the other
changes nothing. An import writes the name without the prefix.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_web_hosting" "site" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

resource "onetsolutions_hosting_database" "shop" {
  hosting_id          = data.onetsolutions_web_hosting.site.id
  name                = "shop"
  deletion_protection = true
}

output "database_name" {
  value = onetsolutions_hosting_database.shop.full_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hosting_id` (String) The UUID of the web hosting. Changing it recreates the object in the other web hosting.
- `name` (String) The name of the database: letters, digits and underscores, at most 16 characters. The web hosting's username and an underscore are prepended unless the name already starts with them (see `full_name`); both spellings are equivalent. Changing it recreates the database, which deletes its data.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Whether destroying (or replacing) the database is refused. Defaults to `false`. Set it to `false` and apply before destroying a protected database.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id` when the object is created; changing it explicitly recreates the object.
- `project_id` (String) The project the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id` when the object is created; changing it explicitly recreates the object.

### Read-Only

- `full_name` (String) The name applications connect to, prefixed with the web hosting's username, such as `acme_shop`.
- `id` (String) The full name of the database, the same as `full_name`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = onetsolutions_hosting_database.shop
  id = "3f2a9c1e-5b7d-4e8f-9a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b/8b1d4e2f-6c3a-4f9e-8d7b-2a1c0e9f8d7c/5e7c2a1b-9d3f-4a6e-8b2c-1d0f9e8a7b6c/acme_shop"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization_id>/<project_id>/<hosting_id>/<name>, or <hosting_id>/<name> when the provider sets organization_id
# and project_id. The name may be given with or without the web hosting's username prefix.
terraform import onetsolutions_hosting_database.shop 3f2a9c1e-5b7d-4e8f-9a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b/8b1d4e2f-6c3a-4f9e-8d7b-2a1c0e9f8d7c/5e7c2a1b-9d3f-4a6e-8b2c-1d0f9e8a7b6c/acme_shop
```
